messages:
Marco (PM): quick sync — we have final interview audio from ClearLoom. need decisions on transcript redlines, embargo date, and which SDR bucket to route inbound leads to.
Sara (Content): dropping the cleaned transcript now — only light edits, flagged 6 lines for quote approval.
Sara (Content): `>> excerpt`
```
"Redwood saved us weeks on latency tuning — our throughput doubled without infra changes."
```
Sara (Content): flagged lines are lines 48, 102, 118 — hoping legal can OK or suggest minimal rewording.
Priya (Legal): thanks — I'll scan. expecting two mins on the quotes but want to confirm ClearLoom signed the media release (I think yes).
Ben (ProdMarketing): for launch copy we want the quote as-is if legal is fine. also want to block a short case study + 60s video clip for the webinar promo. Lina can you mock up a thumbnail with ClearLoom logo?
Lina (Design): yep — can do a square + 16:9. sending drafts by EOD. do we have preferred brand lockups? @Marco
Marco (PM): ClearLoom sent the brand kit — Sara uploaded to the drive (`/marketing/assets/clearloom/brand-kit`).
Sam (SalesOps): routing question — what stage should inbound leads from the case page go to? current options: `MQL`, `SQL`, or `Webinar-Interest`. Our recommendation is `Webinar-Interest` and auto-assign to the regional SDR for NA/EU.
Evan (CS): also add an attribution tag in the form so we know which campaign drove them (utm_campaign=clearloom_case).
Marco (PM): agreed with `Webinar-Interest`. Sam, can you add this quick mapping?
Sam (SalesOps): adding mapping now. snippet for reference:
```json
{
  "source": "case_study_clearloom",
  "route_to": "webinar_interest_queue",
  "assign": {
    "NA": "sdr-na@redwood.com",
    "EU": "sdr-eu@redwood.com",
    "APAC": "sdr-apac@redwood.com"
  }
}
```
Sam (SalesOps): will also wire a simple webhook to the CRM for immediate notify. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Priya (Legal): reviewed quotes — two tiny suggestions: replace "saved us weeks" with "helped reduce tuning time by weeks" and add parenthetical about internal testing. If ClearLoom approves, we're green.
Sara (Content): noted — I'll ping ClearLoom for the OK and push a redlined transcript.
Marco (PM): embargo question — marketing prefers publish on Mon 9am PT, webinar promo running week after. Legal: any constraints?
Priya (Legal): Monday is fine. just need ClearLoom signoff on final quotes and the brand file usage.
Sara (Content): pinging the ClearLoom contact now: @jessica (via email) — copying the two proposed quote variants.
publish-bot: scheduled draft article created at `/cms/drafts/clearloom-usage-story` (ID: dft-4821). publish-bot: please ensure approvals are complete before 1758690000.
Marco (PM): checklist before publish: 1) ClearLoom quote OK, 2) Legal signoff (Priya), 3) Design assets finalized (Lina), 4) Lead routing live (Sam), 5) CS playbook for inbound leads (Evan). I updated the checklist in the doc.
Evan (CS): I'll add a two-step playbook for SDRs (qualify for latency pain, schedule demo), and a canned reply for those who sign up for webinar.
Sam (SalesOps): once I wire the webhook I'll post the test payload here so QA can validate.
Sara (Content): follow-up: should we include the 60s clip in the body of the case study or keep it as a separate promo asset?
Ben (ProdMarketing): separate promo asset — embed the clip on the landing page but keep the case study focused on the narrative + quotes.
Lina (Design): got it — working on thumbnail and 3:4 social crop too.
Marco (PM): great. I'll wait for ClearLoom's redline and legal OK. thanks team — will reconvene tomorrow AM if anything blocks. :raised_hands:
